title: P-3: idempotent host-relaunch entry + fire test with a SIMULATED scheduler (no real OS task installed)
objective: A job killed with no session acting resumes by itself when the relaunch entry fires.
problem: Test harness invokes the entry on a timer; one supervisor per run (idempotent). Write the install command for Task Scheduler/systemd in a doc; do NOT run it.
non_goals: No real OS scheduler task installed on any host
evidence_required: fire test: kill everything, no session acts, simulated scheduler fires, job resumes, digest == control

acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; runner suite green
